title: Ein Sermon von Ablass und Gnade: a digital edition (Taylor Editions, Oxford)
author: Martin Luther
institution: Taylor Institution Library and Faculty of Medieval and Modern Languages, University of Oxford
license_note: XML files are CC BY-SA 4.0; the images are CC BY-NC-ND 4.0.
notes: Transcription of Luther's Sermon von dem Ablass und Gnade (Leipzig print of 1518), with a facsimile, an English translation, linguistic notes and an introduction, and a note on the variant Basel print. Part of the Taylor Editions 'Reformation' pamphlet collection. Count is ours, from the TEI file: about 1,500 words of transcription (notes left out). The edition is dated 2018 (TEI change date 2018-02-14); the Taylor Editions site is online.
